projects.name: IMGG
projects.bio: IMGG is an independent music collective pushing sonic boundaries. Home to the visionary, raw lyricism of Raquiel Onara 988 and the genre-bending production of William Trippe, the label champions bold voices and unfiltered storytelling shaping the next wave of modern sound.

releases.title: No Encore
releases.about:
A dark alternative ballad about choosing silence over continuation. Low-register vocals over warm analog pads, deep sub-bass, and a distorted guitar motif fading like a signal — stepping off the stage before the room asks for more. No second call. No final scene.

"I step off the stage tonight,
Let it end without a sign."
releases.credits: Written and performed by William Trippe.

releases.title: The Black Cube (Saturn Return)
releases.about:
Saturn is not a planet — it's a broadcaster. A dark cinematic boom-bap transmission about the cube at the center of the control grid: the signal coming down, the harvest it feeds, and the escape for anyone who learns to tune it out.

Menacing orchestral string stabs and a heavy, dusty kick under an aggressive, raspy flow — Chronos, the Moon amplifier, and the frequency fence, all on the record.

releases.title: The Strawman (Cestui Que Vie)
releases.about:
Rome didn't fall — it reorganized. A conscious hip-hop excavation of the legal fiction at the center of modern citizenship: the strawman, the Cestui Que Vie trust, the name written in all caps on the paperwork.

Dusty boom bap drums, upright bass and noir jazz piano under a measured, prosecutorial flow — two thousand years of hidden empire, delivered like evidence.

releases.title: Solar Warden
releases.about: A restrained dark pop signal about reclaiming identity from a manufactured world. Low-register vocals, quiet pressure, and memory breaking through the noise. Deep sub-bass, a muted kick, and sparse percussion circle shadowed analog pads and a clean guitar motif, while a low, intimate voice wakes up inside the glass world and remembers its own name. This is not escape — it's remembrance.

releases.title: ARCHON FIELD REPORT
releases.about:
A coded transmission from inside a hidden prison reality. Parasitic forces feed on human emotion through trauma and illusion — the harvest, the soul recycling grid, the loosh. Dark trap at 140 BPM: hard 808s, rapid hi-hats, and a melodic hook carrying a dense lyrical narrative. The call at the end is simple: stop feeding the system and break the loop.

Produced by William Trippe

releases.title: Synthetic Eternity
releases.about: Cinematic industrial shoegaze for the end of the human story — cloned elites in silent chrome towers weave the narrative and control the collective dream, while Raquiel Onara sees the deeper scheme. Detuned piano, sub-bass chant, industrial drums and a commanding female voice over rain and glitching static. "A silent whisper for eternity."

releases.title: The Black Inventory
releases.about:
A ledger of a life, kept in the dark. Every breath itemized, every fear filed by a clerk who never loved the fire but kept the spark — until the case is called in the courtroom of the shade, the debts are counted that never can be paid, and the mirror stops answering to your face. It replies with a ledger.

Produced by William Trippe

releases.title: The Recycling Grid
releases.about:
A song from inside the soul-recycling machine. The Demiurge's prison runs on a wheel — fade out, get purged of the light, get fed back into the grid — while the Archons harvest the loosh from the fear. Painted doors, locked exits, and a moon that whispers "be helpless." Fade out again… or wake up inside the loop.

Produced by William Trippe

releases.title: Isochronic Ascension: 396 to 963
releases.about: Six instrumental meditations built on isochronic pulses, climbing from the root tone at 396 Hz to the crown at 963 Hz. Isochronic Ascension: 396 to 963 opens at the root and rises through the radiant field; Root of the Infinite Dawn, Lucid Radiance, and Infinite Radiant Field carry the ascent; Return to Stillness brings it home, and Golden Isochronic Ascension seals it in gold. Best with headphones, eyes closed, nowhere to be.

releases.title: Source Code Bleeds
releases.about:
The master builder confesses: the perfect world he coded was a cage, and the back-door was his own. As the grid cracks and the red code runs, the ghost in the machine watches his source code bleed.

I drew the grid in sterile white and gold
A perfect world, a story to be told
Each life a function, every choice a line of code
The grand design on which compliance flowed

(The signal's clean... the signal is a lie...)
This perfect cage I built against the sky...

I am the Architect of this beautiful decay!
(The flaw is in the design...)
I gave you order, and I took the light away
(Now watch the source code bleed...)

I wrote the myths that buffer and conceal
The firmware layered deep to make it feel
Like freedom was a product you could buy
Beneath the gaze of an electronic eye

Their generational cycles, century-long arc
I was the weapon they sharpened in the dark
This guilt, a crimson glitch upon the gray
A back-door written for a breakaway

I am the Architect of this beautiful decay!
(The flaw is in the design... the system will not hold)
I gave you order, and now I will betray!
(Watch the whole damn source code bleed...)

(Centralization... is a target...)
(Complexity... brittleness...)
(A... single... truth...)

releases.title: Intra-Body Grid
releases.about:
A clinical system report narrated by an emotionless Administrator, documenting the moment human biology is absorbed into a living network. As nanotech maps the brain and replaces natural pathways, thought becomes data, behavior becomes signal, and the grid quietly declares itself complete.

A microscopic seed is sown beneath the skin.
A set of objects, where the nano-work begins.

Sending signals out on pulses, electric fields.
Self-assembly waiting for the heat the body yields.
Two different strands are fixed within this hostile space.
One in the brain, one for the rest of the human race.

It’s the Intra-Body Grid, can you feel the flow?
Humanity connected, everywhere we go.
Real-time maps of all the secrets in your head.
Neuromodulation, living what is read.
The nanorouters fire, they never let you be.
The network is on, monitoring you and me.

Deep in the grey matter, the CNTs arise.
A mesh over neurons, beneath the sleeping eyes.
They form a short circuit, artificial axons shine.
Picking up the pulse of a neurotransmitter line.
The natural routes are gone, replaced by the new track.
For neurocontrol—there is no turning back.

It’s the Intra-Body Grid, can you feel the flow?
Humanity connected, everywhere we go.
Real-time maps of all the secrets in your head.
Neuromodulation, living what is read.
The nanorouters fire, they never let you be.
The network is on, monitoring you and me.

The Nanorouter grabs the signal, makes it clean.
Encoding with TS-OOK, a binary machine.
Then to the CODEC/Nanointerface, the firewall is thin.
Encryption on the data, before the burst can begin.

The network is on.
The grid is alive.
Monitoring you...
...to thrive... or to drive.
releases.credits: Composer: William TrippeLyricist: William TrippeProducer: William TrippeVocals: William Trippe

releases.title: The Flaw in the Design
releases.about:
An operational report from a fallen Architect who embeds a fatal flaw into the system from within. As memory returns, the vessel exposes layer zero, shatters the illusion, and charts a path toward collective awakening through sabotage and recall.

More music, links, and updates: https://linktr.ee/wtrippe0909

releases.title: The Mind is a Battlefield
releases.about:
A contralto narrator recites a declassified history of mind control—from Cold War experiments to modern neural systems. Told without emotion or judgment, the song reveals a war that never ended, only refined, moving from bodies into signals, circuits, and thought itself.

More music, links, and updates: https://linktr.ee/wtrippe0909

releases.title: The Recovered Name
releases.about:
A fractured architect begins to hear echoes that don't belong to this world. As memory bleeds through code and myth breaks containment, a buried identity resurfaces. This is the moment of awakening—when a false reality collapses and the Solar Warden remembers his name.

More music, links, and updates: https://linktr.ee/wtrippe0909

releases.title: The Stargate Protocol
releases.about:
A trained remote viewer is guided into a sterile, controlled session meant to prove nothing. Following coordinates and names, he crosses internal thresholds and begins witnessing vast, non-human structures beyond sanctioned space. The mission ends, the data is buried—but the visions persist, unresolved and real.

More music, links, and updates: https://linktr.ee/wtrippe0909

releases.title: The Variable of Freedom
releases.about:
The system files its report. The chaos of the human heart — hope, love, dissent — quantified, debugged, and optimized away, until freedom itself is just a variable the system manages and defines. Sterile IDM, a vocoder voice calm as a form letter: compliance is efficiency.

Initializing report seven-delta-nine.
Subject: Inefficient Variables.

The chaos of the human heart, a messy, flawed design
A billion frantic signals that refuse to form a line
We see the raw equation, the error in the sums
The wasted, random energy before the order comes

(x equals desire... y equals the pain...)
(Calculating loss... optimizing gain...)

Compliance is efficiency, the logic is serene
We quantify the spirit, we debug the machine
Freedom is a variable we manage and define
The future is optimized by elegant design

Your hope is just a metric, your love a simple node
We plot it on a graph and then we lighten the whole load
Your dissent is a deviation, a rounding error's ghost
A bug within the system that we neutralize the most

(Plotting protest vectors... projecting the decay...)
(Re-routing behavioral pathways... come what may...)

Compliance is efficiency, the logic is serene
We quantify the spirit, we debug the machine
Freedom is a variable we manage and define
The future is optimized by elegant design

You call it control. We call it stability.
You cling to the unpredictable and call it dignity.
But a perfect system has no room for ghosts or gods or chance.
There is only the equation. The next logical advance.
It's beautiful, isn't it?
So clean.

Report concluded.
System integrity: optimal.

releases.title: Signal Loss
releases.about: A transmission from a place where the people have already left. What's still there is the equipment — a terminal still running, tapes still turning, a signal still trying to get through. Three recordings of that room: a pulse that won't quit, the hum of screens in the dark, tape wearing thinner every time it plays. No voices. Nothing human left except whoever's listening.

releases.title: The Room Leaks
releases.about: A spoken-word piece about the room that tries to balance your losses like a ledger — and the small, rough, ungifted things that leak through it anyway: a hand under the door, a neighbor's kettle, a song you once wrote wrong but keep humming. They do not argue with the dark. They simply persist.

releases.title: The Trail of the White Wolf
releases.about: This album chronicles the true story of Rick Prince, translating his journey from a talented pool hustler in Augusta, Georgia, to a convicted felon, and finally, to a man reborn by faith and dedicated to a new life in the Colorado wilderness. Every track adheres to the raw, soulful sound of Southern Rock & Blues.

releases.title: The Quiet Accounting
releases.about: The Quiet Accounting is a sonic triptych that reframes grief as a bureaucratic process—a quiet foreclosure on the self. Drawing from the framework of Learned Helplessness, the project renders loss as a clinical amputation, where silence acts as administrator and memory functions as an uncompromising debt collector. The trilogy defines the aesthetic of the Brutalist Lullaby, merging the intimate softness of acoustic folk with the cold precision of neoclassical structures, creating a soundscape that is at once devastating, meticulous, and hauntingly beautiful.

releases.title: Plastic Sky Collapse
releases.about: Plastic Sky Collapse is a Gnostic concept album tracing a soul’s violent journey from digital enslavement to divine selfhood. Its sound shifts from hazy lo-fi prisons to industrial noir grit and erupts into symphonic black metal, carrying a multi-vocal trinity: the guttural Decree of forbidden lore, the soaring Lament of resilience, and the epic Choir witnessing the cosmic drama. The narrative follows the shattering of a “plastic sky,” revealing that true liberation lies not in manufactured utopias, but in the brutal alchemy of forging authentic identity from illusion and ash. It is a sonic ritual of disillusionment, awakening, and sovereign reclamation.

releases.title: The Sunken Frequency
releases.about: The Sunken Frequency is a two-part mythic narrative tracing the quest for a lost signal of truth buried beneath layers of systemic control and simulated reality. Act one follows a modern-day war for the soul, moving from ambient whispers of a forgotten past into the industrial-rock defiance of rebellion. Act two chronicles the aftermath, as the rediscovered Codex becomes an absolute monarch, unleashing apocalyptic judgment that escalates into a cosmic war, reframing the struggle as an eternal esoteric battle. Sonically, the album evolves from cinematic trap and esoteric hip-hop into neoclassical darkwave and expansive space rock, completing a full cycle of descent, apotheosis, and the realization that freedom is a fight waged within the heart and across the stars.

releases.title: The True Name of the Codex
releases.about: The True Name of the Codex is a 14-track Gnostic Cyber-Punk opera, blending cold industrial machinery, cinematic synths, and glitching, rebellious anthems. It traces a soul’s harrowing evolution from discovery of a hidden prison to personal reckoning, multi-front rebellion, and ultimate apotheosis, delivering a sovereign gospel forged from the ashes of illusion. Across conspiratorial whispers, digital strongholds, and spiritual battlegrounds, the album becomes a Grimoire, a weaponized document of awakening: the sound of a soul hijacking the system, breaking the script, and manifesting a hacked divinity through the Glitching Serpent Sigil.

tracks.title: The Pyramid of the False Light

releases.title: Resonance of the Architects
releases.about: Welcome to a world where the soil hums with forgotten energy and the air vibrates with broken code. This album lives between ancient and futuristic, a sonic ritual set in a desolate realm of glowing green fire and spectral ruins. Each track becomes an abstract passage into hidden power and quiet apocalypse—an awakening shaped by cosmic forces and the last embers of a dying world. It is the echo of a forest burning with mystical light, the cry of a skeletal figure rising from digital debris, and the reminder that even when everything else fades, the inner flame remains.

releases.title: Unveiling the Sovereign Flame
releases.about: Unveiling the Sovereign Flame blends 80s Synthwave, Retrowave, and Dreamwave into a retro-futuristic sound of neon arpeggios, analog basslines, VHS-soaked pads, and ethereal female vocals. It follows the rise of the inner flame—awakening from shadow, illusion, and static—becoming a story of resilience, revelation, and spiritual alchemy. Each track moves through surreal neon vistas and fractured dreamscapes toward clarity and ascension. More than a record, it is an initiation into sovereignty: an invitation to claim the fire that cannot be extinguished.

releases.title: Ashes of Silence
releases.about: Ashes of Silence is a narrative journey through the quiet rooms of a broken heart, tracing the collapse and transformation of a single psyche. It begins in the ruins of a life and the discovery of a truth that burns the past, then follows a shadow hero waging a cold war against his own pain, forging walls so high they blot out the sun. In fleeting moments of grace, he learns to carry his broken parts, yet the underlying agony endures, culminating in a final, devastating surrender. The album is the sound of quiet despair, introspective defiance, and the haunting peace of feeling nothing at all—a sunbeam on the floor of a tomb.

releases.title: Fractured Crown
releases.about: Fractured Crown fuses Gothic and Symphonic Metal with industrial grit and lo-fi ambience, building a cinematic wall of distorted guitars, ritual percussion, and ethereal–to–feral vocals. It follows a consciousness breaking through illusion and remembering its origin—a story of inner rebellion, metamorphosis, and the reclamation of power. Layered with symbolic and mystical themes, the album moves through fragmentation into integration and transcendence. More than a record, it’s a rite of transformation—an invitation to rise from the ruins and rebuild the throne within.
